sql.value: select tfs.id as id, tfs.account_set_id as accountSetId, tfs.tax_period as taxPeriod, tfs.salary_wages as salaryWages, tfs.salary_wages_tax as salaryWagesTax, tfs.business_income as businessIncome, tfs.business_income_tax as businessIncomeTax, tfs.state_tax as stateTax, tfs.state_tax_amount as stateTaxAmount, tfs.created_at as createdAt, tfs.updated_at as updatedAt, tfi.id as infoId, tfi.salary_wages_enabled as salaryWagesEnabled, tfi.business_income_enabled as businessIncomeEnabled, tfi.tax_handling_old_account as taxHandlingOldAccount, tfi.nature as nature, tfi.remark as remark, tfi.remark1 as remark1, tfi.remark2 as remark2, tfi.remark3 as remark3, tfi.remark4 as remark4, ast.id as accountSetsId, ast.company_name as companyName, ast.credit_code as creditCode, ast.individual_tax_code as individualTaxCode, ast.company_org_type as companyOrgType, ast.province as province, (select tba.city from fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address tba where tba.pin_yin = ast.province limit 1) as provinceName, ast.vat_type as vatType, ast.account_standard as accountStandard, ast.creator_id as creatorId, ast.current_account_date as currentAccountDate, ast.zero_declarations as zeroDeclarations, ast.deactivated as deactivated, DATE_FORMAT(ast.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as accountSetCreateDate, u.real_name as creatorRealName, u.nickname as creatorNickname, u.mobile as creatorMobile, tp.id as taskPeriodId, tp.period as taskPeriod, tp.step_verify as stepVerify, tp.step_init as stepInit, tp.step_data as stepData, tp.step_bookkeep as stepBookkeep, tp.step_tax_national as stepTaxNational, tp.step_tax_iit as stepTaxIit, tp.step_payment as stepPayment, tp.step_annual_report as stepAnnualReport, tp.step_tax_annual as stepTaxAnnual, tp.declare_completed as declareCompleted, tfa.id as annualId, tfa.tax_year as taxYear, tfa.enterprise_annual_report as enterpriseAnnualReport, tfa.industry_commercial_annual_report as industryCommercialAnnualReport, tfa.annual_remark as annualRemark from fxy_financial_account_sets ast inner join fxy_financial_user_account_sets uas on uas.account_sets_id = ast.id inner join fxy_financial_user u on u.id = uas.user_id left join fxy_financial_tax_filing_info tfi on tfi.account_set_id = ast.id left join fxy_financial_tax_filing_status tfs on tfs.account_set_id = ast.id and tfs.tax_period = :taxPeriod left join fxy_financial_task_period tp on tp.account_set_id = ast.id and tp.period = :taxPeriod left join fxy_financial_tax_filing_annual tfa on tfa.account_set_id = ast.id and tfa.tax_year = :taxYear where uas.user_id = :currentUserId and ast.deactivated = b'0' #[and ast.create_date >= :accountSetCreateDateStart] #[and ast.create_date <= :accountSetCreateDateEnd] -- 省份匹配：城市名带括号时（如 厦门（福建）），只按括号前的本名匹配，括号内的所属省份不参与搜索 #[and (ast.province like concat('%', :province, '%') or exists (select 1 from fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address tba2 where tba2.pin_yin = ast.province and substring_index(substring_index(tba2.city, '（', 1), '(', 1) like concat('%', :province, '%')))] #[and ast.company_name like concat('%', :companyName, '%')] #[and ast.credit_code like concat('%', :creditCode, '%')] #[and ast.individual_tax_code like concat('%', :individualTaxCode,'%')] #[and ast.company_org_type like concat('%', :companyOrgType, '%')] #[and ast.vat_type = :vatType] #[and (u.real_name like concat('%', :creatorKeyword, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', :creatorKeyword, '%') or u.mobile like concat('%', :creatorKeyword, '%'))] #[and tfi.tax_handling_old_account like concat('%', :taxHandlingOldAccount, '%')] #[and tfi.nature like concat('%', :nature, '%')] #[and tfi.salary_wages_enabled = :salaryWagesEnabled] #[and tfi.business_income_enabled = :businessIncomeEnabled] <!-- 14 个自由文本字段：多值 + 模糊 + 空值，使用 REGEXP（"^$" 子表达式匹配空字符串） --> #[and ifnull(tfs.salary_wages, '') regexp :salaryWagesRegex] #[and ifnull(tfs.salary_wages_tax, '') regexp :salaryWagesTaxRegex] #[and ifnull(tfs.business_income, '') regexp :businessIncomeRegex] #[and ifnull(tfs.business_income_tax, '') regexp :businessIncomeTaxRegex] #[and ifnull(tfs.state_tax, '') regexp :stateTaxRegex] #[and ifnull(tfs.state_tax_amount, '') regexp :stateTaxAmountRegex] #[and ifnull(tfa.enterprise_annual_report, '') regexp :enterpriseAnnualReportRegex] #[and ifnull(tfa.industry_commercial_annual_report, '') regexp :industryCommercialAnnualReportRegex] #[and ifnull(tfa.annual_remark, '') regexp :annualRemarkRegex] #[and ifnull(tfi.remark, '') regexp :remarkRegex] #[and ifnull(tfi.remark1, '') regexp :remark1Regex] #[and ifnull(tfi.remark2, '') regexp :remark2Regex] #[and ifnull(tfi.remark3, '') regexp :remark3Regex] #[and ifnull(tfi.remark4, '') regexp :remark4Regex] order by ast.display_order asc, ast.id desc

select tti.id as id, tti.task_period_id as taskPeriodId, tti.tax_name as taxName, tti.declare_period as declarePeriod, tti.declare_deadline as declareDeadline, tti.declare_status as declareStatus, tti.declared_amount as declaredAmount, tti.declare_result as declareResult, tti.screenshot_urls as screenshotUrls, tti.error_msg as errorMsg, tti.executed_at as executedAt, tti.sort_order as sortOrder from fxy_financial_task_tax_item tti inner join fxy_financial_task_period tp on tp.id = tti.task_period_id where tp.account_set_id = :accountSetId and tp.period = :taxPeriod order by tti.sort_order asc, tti.id asc

select tis.id as id, tis.task_period_id as taskPeriodId, tis.sub_type as subType, tis.status as status, tis.declare_result as declareResult, tis.screenshot_url as screenshotUrl, tis.error_msg as errorMsg, tis.executed_at as executedAt from fxy_financial_task_iit_sub tis inner join fxy_financial_task_period tp on tp.id = tis.task_period_id where tp.account_set_id = :accountSetId and tp.period = :taxPeriod order by tis.id asc
